subject: Intro: TrustBridge Catalyst — Redwood SDK pilot & tracing integration
messages:
From: Emma Rhodes <emma.rhodes@trustbridge.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: TrustBridge Catalyst — Redwood SDK pilot & tracing integration

Hi Vanessa,

Really appreciate the intro earlier this week from our mutual contact. I lead partnerships at TrustBridge — we build 'Catalyst', a lightweight orchestration layer and prompt-tooling suite used by consultancies and ISVs to standardize LLM prompt flows and tracing. Several of our customers have asked for a tighter runtime instrumentation and direct SDK-level integration with Redwood so they can preserve end-to-end traces and cost/fidelity metrics.

High-level ask: we’d like to run a small pilot to validate:
- LangChain and LlamaIndex connector compatibility with Redwood's SDK
- Trace propagation (request id, model variant, routing policy) from Catalyst into Redwood Console
- Prompt/response fidelity checks and cost deltas with Catalyst pre/post-processing turned on

We attached a short overview of Catalyst and a one-page pilot scope. Proposed next step: 30–45m technical sync + a parallel commercial chat to align on a simple MOU for a 6-week pilot.

Available windows next week (PST): Wed 11/04 09:00–11:00 or Thu 11/05 13:00–16:00.

Thanks — happy to iterate the scope.

Emma Rhodes
Head of Partnerships | TrustBridge Consulting
emma.rhodes@trustbridge.ai
[Attachment: TrustBridge-Catalyst-overview.pdf (pdf)]

Quick answers up front: we’ve got customers using both LangChain and LlamaIndex on top of Redwood, and our SDK supports header-based trace propagation today. The pilot you outline sounds reasonable. I’ve looped in Marissa (partnerships) to coordinate commercial terms and Ben (SE) to scope the technical checklist.

Marissa — can you own the MOU draft? Ben — can you review Catalyst PDF and flag any immediate integration blockers?

Emma — Wed 11/04 09:30 PST works for me if that’s still open. If you prefer Thu afternoon, Marissa has some availability then as well.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rhodes <emma.rhodes@trustbridge.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: TrustBridge Catalyst — Redwood SDK pilot & tracing integration

Emma — I read the Catalyst overview and sketched a quick technical checklist for the sync. Key compatibility notes below.

Summary (high level):
- LangChain / LlamaIndex connectors: Catalyst's connector layer is fine; we recommend instrumenting at the SDK call boundary so Redwood sees unmodified inputs + Catalyst post-processing as separate spans.
- Trace propagation: use X-Redwood-Trace and X-Catalyst-Id headers; Redwood Console accepts and stores arbitrary trace metadata but we need to agree on field names for model_variant, routing_policy, and cost_token_count.
- Auth & deployment modes: pilot can run against Redwood Sandbox (hosted) or a Dedicated test pool. If TrustBridge needs private telemetry, we can support a Private deployment with a short onboarding (2–3 weeks).
- Data handling: Catalyst sometimes buffers prompts for local caching — outline required retention policy and redaction rules.

Suggested pilot test-plan (minimal):
1) Basic request flow: LangChain -> Catalyst -> Redwood SDK -> model (verify headers propagated and Console trace entry).
2) Prompt transform test: verify fidelity delta when Catalyst applies prompt templating.
3) Load sanity: ramp to 50 rps for 15 minutes on sandbox and validate autoscaling/fallback behavior.

Attachments: seed config (redwood-seed-config.yaml) and a tiny sample showing how to set X-Redwood-Trace in a LangChain wrapper. I’ll paste the sample at the meeting if helpful.

Also: for security questionnaire items, please send the form and our security team will triage (SOC2 artifact portal link below).

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-seed-config.yaml (yaml)]
[Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcExampleSharedDrive]
From: Emma Rhodes <emma.rhodes@trustbridge.ai>

Subject: Re: Intro: TrustBridge Catalyst — Redwood SDK pilot & tracing integration

Thanks all — confirmed for Thu 11/05 13:00 PST. Attendees from TrustBridge: myself, our engineering lead Luke James <l.james@trustbridge.ai>, and our security SME security@trustbridge.ai. Luke will bring a short demo of the Catalyst connector for LangChain.

Security note: I’ve attached the standard security questionnaire; our legal team expects SOC2 Type II evidence and a simple DPA for the pilot. If you can point us to the SOC2 portal and a sample DPA, that would speed review.

Ben — appreciate the checklist. Two quick clarifications:
- We prefer header names to be catalyst.trace_id and catalyst.meta.* to avoid collisions; can Redwood map those to Console fields?
- For the private telemetry option: what are typical lead times and cost bands for a short-lived Private deployment?

Emma Rhodes
Head of Partnerships | TrustBridge Consulting
